sloka: इति पृष्टस्तु भरतं भ्रातृदर्शनलालसम् ।प्रत्युवाच महातेजा भरद्वाजो महातपा: ॥ २.९२.९॥
transliteration: iti pṛṣṭastu bharataṁ bhrātṛdarśanalālasam ।pratyuvāca mahātejā bharadvājo mahātapā: ॥ 2.92.9॥

translations.english: Thus questioned, the great sage, brilliant Bharadwaja replied to Bharata who was yearning to see his brother:
